entries.b6c1da6ccaef6c18: It regards conversion to a business structure that can be left to the next generation and promotion of sustainability management as its most important issues, and under its Vision it is implementing the 4th Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026), "Step2 toward a next-generation business responding to changes in industrial structure." Its basic policies are continuous improvement of its business portfolio from a medium- to long-term perspective and consideration and implementation of necessary investment, implementation of capital and financial policies that make that possible, and further promotion of sustainability management. For bulk cargo, it has begun constructing a highly versatile bulk cargo warehouse and is advancing construction toward completion during fiscal 2026, and for liquid cargo, in anticipation of shrinking demand for coal, it is considering newly building stainless tanks for petrochemical products on open storage land.
